title: One chip. Part 6 (finale)
note: Silent finale, no vote, no phones after 3 s. Frame 1 fully composed, no fade, ONE strip: his phone lit mid-swipe (1.5x, generic profile card + heart badge, no UI), two big faces outside the closed store (shutter down) with a CAFE across the street between them, her holding the chip so, what's / your name? Hook b only: she catches him (her eyes drop to his lit screen, one raised brow, a ! badge, he flinches). 3.0 s: plain-context strip, phone goes dark and into his pocket. Take 1 (B fails on him): LADDER GUY, she reads flat, writes i'll wait / for the real one. and heads for the cafe alone. Fan snaps shut (rewind. take 2.). Take 2 (A): THEO whole-frame close-up, she smiles (music drops out), flips it, writes june. / hi, theo. (close-up), shared laugh. Payoff: she pulls out the very first chip (SAME), tapes it to POPPY, close-up POPPY + SAME. They cross the street to the cafe, silhouettes in the window with two cups. End card fifty whites / the end / follow for the next story. No NoSwipe mention, no vote.

strips.text: we met in a paint aisle. we only talked on paint chips.
so I wrote my real name.
she pulled out the very first chip.
fifty whites. we picked the same one.
